data-co-data.subject: Hold SFMTA Accountable to the Law: Build Bikeways When We Repave
data-co-data.body:
I live in San Francisco, and I want a bike network that's safe enough for kids and seniors. The city adopted the Biking and Rolling Plan in March 2025. Since the plan passed, SFMTA has added under 5 of the 255 miles still to build. Even at the last ten years' pace, it won't be finished until after 2050.

City law already requires adding the planned bikeway when a street is repaved. The city repaved 7.9 miles of plan streets that needed a better bikeway and added a bikeway on only 0.7 of those miles.

Please hold SFMTA more accountable to the law.

Here's the data: https://sf-works.org/transportation/bike/

Thank you,
[Your name and neighborhood]
